_comment: The Python packages of VGAC's own ComfyUI, one exact wheel each for CPython 3.13 on 64-bit Windows. Versions are the ones the owner's working engine runs (ComfyUI 0.45.3, Python 3.13.12, torch 2.12.1+cu130, SkinToken), cut to the closure of ComfyUI 0.45.3's requirements.txt and ComfyUI-SkinToken's. Sizes and SHA-256 were read from PyPI's JSON API and from the PyTorch cu130 index page on 2026-11-15; no file was downloaded to make this list. Every wheel is fetched by the app's downloader and checked against its SHA-256, then installed offline by uv with --require-hashes --no-deps.

wheels.name: numpy
wheels.licence: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0

wheels.name: torch
wheels.licence: BSD-3-Clause style (PyTorch's LICENSE); the CUDA libraries inside are NVIDIA's, under NVIDIA's licence
